commands.id: Show your user ID and this chat ID
commands.register: Activate the bot in this group (owner only)
commands.unregister: Deactivate the bot in this group (owner only)
commands.undone: Mark a task as not done: /undone 12

start.private: 👋 Hi! I collect tasks from Telegram groups. Your Telegram user ID: {userId} If you run this bot, put that number in OWNER_TELEGRAM_ID. Add me to a group and send /register there to activate me. Send /help to see all commands.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.groupOnly: This command only works in groups.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the bot owner can do that.
errors.notRegistered: This group is not activated yet. The bot owner has to send /register here first.
errors.usageNumber: Please add the task number, for example: /{command} 12
errors.taskNotFound: There is no task #{number} in this group.
errors.taskRecording: Task #{number} is still being recorded. Finish or cancel the recording first.

register.success: ✅ This group is now active. Anyone here can start a task with /new.

unregister.success: This group has been deactivated. Existing tasks are kept; send /register to activate it again.

joined.hint: 👋 Thanks for adding me! The bot owner needs to send /register here to activate task recording.

task.recordingStarted: 🎙 Recording task #{number}. Everything sent in this group from now on (text, voice, photos, videos, files) will be added to it, no matter who sends it. Press Finish when you are done.
task.alreadyRecording: Task #{number} is still being recorded. Finish or cancel it before starting a new one.
task.noneRecording: No task is being recorded right now. Send /new to start one.
task.editCancelled: ✖ Editing of task #{number} was cancelled. The task is unchanged.
task.emptyDiscarded: Nothing was recorded, so task #{number} was discarded.

callback.stale: This task is no longer being recorded.
callback.notYours: Only the person who asked for this (or the bot owner) can confirm it.

capture.fileTooBig: ⚠️ This file is larger than 20 MB, so it could not be saved with the task.
capture.downloadFailed: ⚠️ This file could not be downloaded. The message was recorded without it.
capture.transcriptionFailed: ⚠️ This voice message could not be transcribed. It is kept as an audio file.

list.empty: No tasks yet. Send /new to record the first one.

status.alreadyDone: Task #{number} is already marked as done.
status.alreadyOpen: Task #{number} is already marked as not done.

delete.confirm: 🗑 Delete task #{number} and all of its files? {title} This cannot be undone.
